errors.text_span: Es gibt drei Linien in dem Diagramm: Eine grüne Linie, die „Differenz Zufluss-Abfluss“ darstellt,
errors.evidence: The chart is a combination of a bar chart and a line chart. The "Differenz Zufluss-Abfluss" is represented by green bars, not a green line. There are only two lines (blue and purple).
This phrase is contradictory, first identifying the data series as a line and then as bars within the same sentence.
The value for the bar in 2020 is +27,499. The value -81,484 corresponds to the year 2021.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie, die „Abfluss“ darstellt, beginnt bei 43,268 in 2005 und steigt auf 51,275 in 2014, sinkt anschließend auf 39,552 in 2018 und endet bei 27,499 in 2020.
errors.evidence: None of the values reported for the blue "Abfluss" line are correct. The values have been incorrectly taken from other data series in the chart. For example, in 2005 the blue line is at approximately 65,000, while the value reported (43,268) is the approximate value of the purple "Zufluss" line. The value 27,499 for 2020 is the value of the green bar for that year.

errors.text_span: Die violette Linie, die „Zufluss“ darstellt, beginnt bei 76,054 in 2005, erreicht einen Höchstwert von 144,923 in 2010, sinkt dann auf 118,575 in 2018 und endet bei 68,045 in 2022.
errors.evidence: All of the data points cited for the purple line are incorrect and do not match the values shown in the chart. For example, in 2005 the line starts at approximately 43,000, not 76,054. In 2010, the value is approximately 67,000, not 144,923. The reported numbers appear to be hallucinations.
